# Perfxcel

> Performance Management Platform. Drive organizational alignment and elevate employee performance tracking.

## Overview
Perfxcel empowers organizations to implement transparent, goal-oriented performance management. From continuous feedback to structured appraisals, Perfxcel aligns employee growth with business objectives.

## Key Features
- **Goal Tracking:** Set, track, and measure OKRs and KPIs.
- **Continuous Feedback:** 360-degree feedback tools to foster a culture of recognition.
- **Appraisal Workflows:** Streamlined review cycles with customizable templates.
- **Analytics & Insights:** Identify top performers and skill gaps instantly.
